entities.name: Teyo Verada
entities.description: A young, inexperienced shield mage and planeswalker, thrust into the chaos of war and still learning what it means to be a planeswalker.

events.summary: Teyo is unexpectedly thrust into the chaos of war and survives deadly trials against all odds.
